title: Application for Rectification of Mistake Apparent from the Record under Section 154 of the Income-tax Act, 1961
whenToUse: Use when an Assessing Officer or CPC Bengaluru has issued an intimation or order under Section 143(1)/143(3) containing a patent clerical or calculation error, such as denial of TDS credit or MAT credit.
variantComparisonNote: Administrative rectification under Section 154 before Assessing Officer. Distinct from formal first appeal before CIT (Appeals) under Section 246A.
youWillNeed: Copy of ITR-V, intimation under Section 143(1), Form 26AS / AIS / TIS showing tax deductions, challans of advance tax.
legalBasis: Section 154 Income-tax Act, 1961; T.S. Balaram, ITO v. Volkart Brothers (1971); Section 244A (Interest on refunds).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Mistake is patent, obvious, and apparent from the face of the record
No contentious or debatable question of law involved
Application filed within 4 years from the end of the financial year in which order was passed
Specific claim for credit of prepaid taxes and interest under Section 244A

particulars.label: Assessing Officer Designation
particulars.description: Designation of Jurisdictional AO or CPC Bengaluru

particulars.label: Disputed / Rectification Sum (INR)
particulars.description: Amount of wrongly computed demand or refund denied

aiBlocks.title: Filing Background & Impugned Intimation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail filing of return of income for AY {{FACT:assessment_year}}, receipt of intimation under Section 143(1), and creation of unlawful demand or reduction of refund.

aiBlocks.title: Demonstration of Mistake Apparent from Record
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Demonstrate glaring mistake apparent from record regarding TDS credit appearing in Form 26AS/AIS, clerical computational error, and application of Section 154.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Rectification & Revised Refund
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Pray for rectification of intimation, grant of lawful tax credit, cancellation of demand of ₹{{FACT:rectification_amount}}/- and issuance of refund with interest under Section 244A.
